events.name: Toronto Blue Jays at Baltimore Orioles

headlines.description: — Pete Alonso homered twice, including a two-run shot in the eighth inning that lifted the Baltimore Orioles to a 4-3 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pete Alonso homers twice to reach 40 on the season, helps Orioles rally to 4-3 win over Blue Jays

headlines.description: — River Ryan was outstanding in his Detroit debut and the Tigers hit three home runs to rout the Washington Nationals 9-2 on Monday night, one day after being eliminated from the American League playoff race.
headlines.shortLinkText: River Ryan makes strong debut and Tigers hit 3 home runs in 9-2 win over Nationals

events.name: Minnesota Twins at San Francisco Giants

headlines.description: — Drew Gilbert homered and hit a two-run single, leading the San Francisco Giants past the Minnesota Twins 5-2 on Monday night to snap a three-game losing streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Drew Gilbert's homer and 2-run single lead Giants past Twins 5-2 to end 3-game losing streak
